title: Segmented quarterly roadmap: Hosted API + Model Catalog runways
creator: Maya Chen
project: Hosted API Model Catalog Q2 Runway
description: Create a segmented quarterly roadmap and tactical sprint lanes for the Hosted API + Model Catalog product surface. The goal is to align initiatives to three commercial segments (AI-native startups, mid-market SaaS, platform teams) and map each initiative to OKRs, capacity needs, canary windows, and gating criteria for model onboarding. Deliverables include a stakeholder-ready deck, sprint lane assignments, a dependency matrix, and a deployment and rollback playbook for model rotation and canaries.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap deck published to Confluence and shared with GTM, Eng, Design
Initiatives mapped to specific OKRs with measurable signals and targets
Capacity assumptions and required Dedicated/VPC commitments documented by platform engineering
Canary windows and rollback triggers defined for model swaps and endpoint substitutions
Cross-functional dependencies identified and owners assigned
Sign-off from VP Product and Head of Infrastructure
notes: Focus on three segment runways so engineering can size Dedicated capacity vs hosted burst capacity separately.
Avoid overloading the Q2 cadence with more than two model onboarding experiments per segment to preserve canary fidelity.
We will use the Optimize toolkit to generate initial quantization recommendations for cost-sensitive segments.
Plan to treat model pruning/deprecation as a first-class initiative with a 6-week notice and migration playbook.
